newsitem.title: CHINA: Jingwei Textile wins 40 mln yuan orders.
newsitem.headline: Jingwei Textile wins 40 mln yuan orders.

text.p: Jingwei Textile Machinery Co has won 40 million yuan worth of new orders at an international textile machinery exhibition being held in Beijing, the China Securities said on Tuesday.
The newspaper did not say whether these were firm orders or preliminary accords and gave no further details.
The company, which listed H shares in Hong Kong in Feburary, had pre-tax profits of 74.384 million yuan and net profits of 43.117 million yuan in the first eight months of this year.
Sales reached 433.076 million yuan over the same period, the paper said.
